$schema_note: Canonical product-recommendation seed data — Phase 2A analysis output. Intentionally EMPTY. See notes below and docs/catalogue/catalogue-decisions-required.md.
notes: No curated/persisted product-recommendation dataset exists anywhere in the current codebase. src/routes/product.$id.tsx computes 'related products' at render time as `products.filter(p => p.category === product.category && p.id !== product.id).slice(0, 4)` — a same-category fallback, not stored data.

'Recently viewed' (src/lib/store.ts recentlyViewed, capped at 12) is a per-browser localStorage list of product ids the customer viewed, not a recommendation relationship between products — it is customer session data, out of catalogue scope.

Per the 'do not invent business data' rule (Phase 2A instructions) and 'no fake business values' more broadly, this file ships with zero entries rather than materializing the current same-category fallback as if it were curated data. The recommended next step (see catalogue-migration-plan.md) is to keep the same-category fallback as the API's default recommendation strategy until/unless a real curated recommendations feature is scoped.
Schema below is provided so the shape is ready for future population, whether by admin curation or a future recommendation-engine sync.

schema.product_external_key: string — the product recommendations are shown for
schema.rank: integer — 1-based display order within the recommendation list
